Baker's Percentage Calculator

Baker's percentages are always relative to the combined weight of all flours as 100% — never to the total dough weight, and never to each flour separately. Enter a formula once and get per-ingredient weights for a target total or a flour weight, or work back from weighed amounts to percentages and hydration.

Calculation mode

Formula (percentages are always relative to the combined flour weight)
Ingredient Percentage (%) Flour Water Weight (g) Action

Total dough weight: — g

Hydration: —% (hydration = ingredients flagged as water ÷ all flour; milk, eggs and similar count only if you flag them as water — this tool never guesses from a name.)

In Mode A the total shown is the exact target you entered; each row's weight is rounded independently to 0.1 g, so the displayed weights can add up to a few tenths of a gram more or less than the total.

Everything is computed locally: no network, no storage, no tracking. Percentages are rounded like weights, to 0.1 with halves rounded up. Your formula never appears in the URL or the page title.
